Innate: Shyvana generates Scalemail stacks from scoring takedowns against certain enemies. Large monsters and large minions grant 1 stack, while enemy champions and epic monsters grant 3.
Scalemail: For each stack, Shyvana gains 0.4 bonus armor and 0.4 bonus magic resistance .

Passive: Shyvana's basic attacks on-hit deal bonus magic damage equal to 1% (+ 1.7 % per 100 bonus AD) (+ 1.3 % per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health . Against non-champions, this damage deals a minimum of 10 and is capped at 200. Additionally, her basic attacks on-hit reduce the remaining cooldown of Emberstrike by 1.25 seconds.

Active: Shyvana empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup , gain 50 bonus range and trigger a blast in the target's direction that deals 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 (+ 110% AD) (+ 25% AP) modified physical damage to enemies hit in a cone. Emberstrike's damage to the primary target is affected by critical strike modifiers. After 1.5 seconds of using the empowered attack, or immediately after her next basic attack, Shyvana can recast Emberstrike within and up to the next 4 seconds.
First Recast: Shyvana mimics the first cast's effects, instead creating the blast around the primary target.

Dragon Form Bonus: After 1.5 seconds of using the recast's empowered attack, or immediately after her next basic attack, Shyvana can recast Emberstrike a second time within and up to the next 4 seconds.

Second Recast: Shyvana empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup , gain 50 bonus range and cause her to bite the target, dealing them 15 / 22.5 / 30 / 37.5 / 45 (+ 165% AD) (+ 37.5 % AP) modified true damage . This attack cannot critically strike .
Emberstrike's empowered attack deals 10 bonus damage to monsters.
All Emberstrike casts reset Shyvana's basic attack timer.
Cooldown: 10 / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 seconds (starts post-effect).
Cast Time: None, Effect Radius: 275 .

Active: Shyvana grants herself a shield for 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 (+ 5% maximum health) for 2.5 seconds, increased by 30% for every nearby enemy champion . While the shield holds, she gains 25% bonus movement speed , increased to 43.75 % while facing visible enemy champions .
After 1 second, Inferno Aegis can be recast while the shield holds and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.
Recast: Shyvana consumes the shield to unleash an explosion around her, dealing 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies.

Dragon Form Bonus: If the recast's explosion hits an enemy champion , Shyvana heals for 100 – 267.65 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 5% AP) , increased by 0% – 100% (based on missing health) for a maximum heal of 200 – 535.29 (based on level) (+ 20% bonus AD) (+ 10% AP) .

Active: Shyvana launches a fireball in the target direction that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 70% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies and slowing them by 30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50% for 2 seconds.

Dragon Form Bonus: Molten Burst's fireball damage is increased by 25%. The fireball is wider, can pass through enemies, and scorches the ground along its path for 2 seconds. Upon hitting an enemy champion or large monster, or reaching maximum range, the fireball triggers an explosion centered around the target or location that deals the same damage to nearby enemies and applies the same slow. The explosion also scorches the ground in the same radius for 2 seconds. Enemies within a scorched field are dealt 3.75 / 5 / 6.25 (based on level) (+ 1.25 % AP) magic damage every 0.25 seconds, for a total maximum damage of 30 / 40 / 50 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) . Enemies may be damaged by only one scorched field at a time. Subsequent explosions that hit the same target deal 50% damage.
